objects.name: Cyber_Horus
objects.description: Egypt-linked threat group. Conducted confirmed intrusions against Ethiopian government networks in 2020, attributed by INSA. Activity linked to geopolitical tensions over the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam.

objects.name: Spearphishing Attachment
objects.description: Sending emails with malicious attachments to targeted government officials.

objects.name: Valid Accounts: Domain Accounts
objects.description: Using compromised domain credentials to blend in with normal activity.

objects.description: Using PowerShell for execution and living-off-the-land.

objects.description: Using HTTP/HTTPS for C2 communication to blend with normal traffic.
